reading.body:
Anastasis Germanidis co-founded Runway in 2018 and led its technology as CTO for over seven years before moving into the Co-CEO role in 2026, making him one of the longest-serving technical executives at any major generative-video company.

His path to Runway combined backend engineering at Quantcast, Chartbeat, and Zocdoc with machine learning and computer vision research at IBM Research, alongside graduate study in human-computer interaction at NYU. That combination, practical infrastructure work plus research exposure plus interaction design, maps directly onto what generative video requires: systems that can handle large model outputs and deliver them to non-specialist users.

The data covers his career chronology and current title but does not include information about Runway's compute infrastructure, energy consumption, or the scale of its training operations. His significance for understanding AI development lies in the organizational layer, how a technical co-founder transitions into executive leadership at a compute-intensive company, rather than in the hardware and power layer the broader site covers.

standing.standing: Anastasis Germanidis stands as co-founder and Co-CEO of Runway, the generative-video company he helped start in November 2018 and has led continuously since. The records show he served as CTO for over seven years before becoming Co-CEO in 2026, so his influence at the company runs from its founding through its current leadership. The site lists Runway twice, once as a company he founded and once as a company where he is an executive, both recorded as a New York startup founded in 2018. No funding or valuation figures appear for Runway in these records, so the scale of what he controls is not quantified here. Before Runway he worked in machine learning and computer vision at IBM Research and held backend engineering roles at Zocdoc, Chartbeat, and Quantcast. He holds an MPS in Human-Computer Interaction from New York University and a BA in Computer Science from Wesleyan University.
